plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate leveraged ETF exposure.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower drawdown. Returns will be modest, but risk is substantially reduced.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 1% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Reduce SPY to 25% to address concentration and meet the mandate.
Buy CCJ, targeting 4% of the book, as a strong scanner setup.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding quality setups. Expect moderate returns with controlled risk.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.
Add to SOXL, targeting 6%, and SPAL, targeting 6%, to increase leveraged exposure.
Buy CCJ, targeting 6% of the book, as a high-scoring scanner setup.
Initiate a position in RGTI, targeting 5%, based on its strong scanner setup.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this raises both upside and drawdown potential, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay/rebalancing.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30% of the book, to prioritize income.
Increase QQQ to 20% to add broad index exposure for stability.
This plan focuses on generating steady monthly distributions.
income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, prioritizing steady distributions. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta names, focusing on income and broad index ETFs. While aiming for low drawdown, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
